Organization.title: Organization
Organization.subtitle: Settings that apply to every workspace in your organization.
Organization.noAccessBody: Only organization owners and admins can change these settings.

OrgOverview.identityDescription: The name every workspace in this organization shares.
OrgOverview.nameHint: Changing this updates the name everywhere in Connex.
OrgOverview.slugHint: This ID appears in links and can't be changed here.
OrgOverview.stale: The organization changed while you were editing. Refresh and try again.
OrgOverview.layoutDescription: Your workspaces and who belongs to them.
OrgOverview.lifecycleDescription: Export everything in a workspace, or permanently delete a workspace or the whole organization. We'll ask for your passkey first.
OrgOverview.rosterRestricted: You'll see who's in this workspace once you join it.
OrgOverview.workspacesEmpty: This organization has no active workspaces.
OrgOverview.loadMoreFailed: Couldn't load more of the organization layout
OrgOverview.loadFailedBody: Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
OrgOverview.switchInProgress: Something else is still running. Try again in a moment.
OrgOverview.navigationFailed: Couldn't open that workspace or member

OrgDataLifecycle.ownerAuthority: You're an organization owner, so you can export workspaces and permanently delete a workspace or the whole organization.
OrgDataLifecycle.adminAuthority: You're an organization admin, so you can export workspaces. Only an owner can delete one.
OrgDataLifecycle.plaintextDescription: It can hold personal information about real people, and anyone who opens the file can read it. Encrypt it wherever you store it, share it only with people who should see it, and delete it when you're done.
OrgDataLifecycle.noWorkspaces: There are no workspaces to export or delete.
OrgDataLifecycle.organizationTeardownDescription: This deletes every workspace, everyone's access, every setting, and every file — and then the organization itself.
OrgDataLifecycle.ownerOnlyTitle: Only an organization owner can delete this
OrgDataLifecycle.ownerOnlyDescription: Owning a workspace isn't the same as owning the organization. Ask an organization owner to do this.
OrgDataLifecycle.confirmWorkspaceDescription: We'll ask for your passkey before deleting this workspace.
OrgDataLifecycle.confirmOrganizationDescription: We'll ask for your passkey before deleting this organization and every workspace in it.
OrgDataLifecycle.workspaceRetention: Every record and file in this workspace is deleted. The audit log and any closed privacy requests are kept, with the links to this workspace and to the people in it removed. Backup copies are erased when they expire.
OrgDataLifecycle.organizationRetention: Every workspace, everyone's access, every setting, every file, and every closed privacy request is deleted, and so is the organization. The audit log is kept, with its link to this organization removed. Backup copies are erased when they expire.
OrgDataLifecycle.confirmationHint: Capital letters and spaces have to match exactly.
OrgDataLifecycle.workspaceOpenObligation: This workspace still has an open privacy request. Close or refuse it, then delete the workspace again.
OrgDataLifecycle.organizationOpenObligation: This organization still has an open privacy request. Close or refuse every one of them, then delete the organization again.
OrgDataLifecycle.teardownFailed: Couldn't finish the deletion. Refresh the page and check before trying again.

OrgAi.title: AI provider
OrgAi.subtitle: Choose the AI service this organization uses. Before sending text, Connex replaces email addresses, phone numbers, and anything it can match to one of your records — but a name typed into a note can go as written. Images, business cards included, are sent as the pictures they are; only hidden camera data such as location is removed. AI stays off until you finish setting this up.
OrgAi.workspaceEnableDescription: Turning this off blocks AI for everyone in this workspace, whatever their role — including answers already being written.
OrgAi.assistantMaxStepsDescription: How many steps Ask Connex may take to reach one answer, from 1 to 12. More steps means more thorough, slower answers.
OrgAi.governanceSaveFailed: Couldn't save the workspace AI controls
OrgAi.dailyBudgetTitle: Daily AI limit for the organization
OrgAi.dailyBudgetDescription: One shared limit for every workspace in this organization. It resets at midnight UTC.
OrgAi.budgetSaveFailed: Couldn't save the daily AI limit
OrgAi.enableDescription: Let members use AI features in this organization's workspaces, if their role allows it.
OrgAi.enableRequiresAttestation: You'll need to confirm the statement below first.
OrgAi.bedrockModelIdHint: A Bedrock Claude model or inference-profile ID, e.g. anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0.
OrgAi.azureEndpointHint: Your Azure OpenAI resource URL, e.g. https://your-resource.openai.azure.com.
OrgAi.vertexRegionHint: A Vertex AI location, e.g. asia-northeast1 or us-central1.
OrgAi.serviceAccountJsonHint: Paste the JSON key file for a service account with Vertex AI access. You won't be able to see it again.
OrgAi.genericEndpointHint: The address of an OpenAI-compatible service, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1.
OrgAi.allowInternalDescription: Allow an address on your own network. Only available if whoever runs Connex for you permits it.
OrgAi.attestLabel: Our contract with this provider rules out training on our data and long-term retention of it
OrgAi.attestDescription: Check your contract before you tick this. AI can't be turned on without it.
OrgAi.credentialKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the key you already saved. You won't be able to see it again.
OrgAi.saveFailed: Couldn't save the AI provider settings
OrgAi.stepUpRequired: Confirm it's you first. Go to Settings → Security, verify your identity, then try again.
OrgAi.loadFailed: Couldn't load the AI provider settings
OrgAi.revokeFailed: Couldn't revoke the AI provider settings

OrgMembers.title: Administrators
OrgMembers.subtitle: People who manage this organization's settings. This is separate from belonging to a workspace.
OrgMembers.roleOwnerHint: Can change everything, including who else is an administrator.
OrgMembers.roleAdminHint: Can change organization settings, but can't add or remove administrators.
OrgMembers.removeConfirmBody: {name} will lose organization administrator access. Their workspace membership is unaffected.
OrgMembers.lastOwnerTooltip: An organization must keep at least one owner. Promote another owner first.
OrgMembers.addSubtitle: Add someone who already has a Connex account, by email address.

OrgDomains.title: Allowed domains
OrgDomains.subtitle: Only people with one of these email domains can join a workspace in this organization. This covers email invites, join links, and single sign-on. Leave it empty to allow anyone.
OrgDomains.label: Email domain
OrgDomains.empty: Anyone can be invited, whatever their email address. Add a domain to narrow that down.
OrgDomains.loadError: Couldn't load allowed domains. Refresh to try again.

OrgAudit.title: Audit log
OrgAudit.subtitle: Changes to sign-in, administrators, and allowed domains. Changes to records show up in each workspace's own audit log.

workspace_member.sso_provision: Workspace membership granted by single sign-on

login.federated_link: Signed in with a linked single sign-on identity

ai_provider.zdr_attest: Confirmed the AI provider keeps no copy of our data

secret.rewrap: Stored credential re-encrypted with the current key

OrgDataRequests.title: Data-subject requests
OrgDataRequests.subtitle: Track disclosure, correction, and cease-of-use requests under the APPI, and assemble disclosure exports for verified requests.
OrgDataRequests.empty: No data-subject requests yet. Log one when a request arrives; disclosure exports need a linked contact and recorded identity verification.
OrgDataRequests.loadError: Couldn't load the requests. Try again in a moment.
OrgDataRequests.disclosureDownloaded: Disclosure export downloaded. Apply statutory redactions before sharing it with the subject.
OrgDataRequests.createDescription: Record who is asking, which right they invoke, and when it arrived.
OrgDataRequests.editDescription: Update the lifecycle as verification, response, and closure happen.
OrgDataRequests.subjectLinkHint: Optional, but required before a disclosure export can be assembled.
OrgDataRequests.fieldIdentityVerifiedHint: Disclosure exports refuse to assemble until this is recorded.
